title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28632v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. translated_title: 关节、相机、开拍！为任意骨架绑定共同生成3D动作与视频
translated_abstract: 视频生成模型如今已能描绘极为逼真的动作。然而，如何将这些动作用于像素之外的领域仍不明确：即为特定的3D资产制作动画，并在其3D场景中回放该动画。例如，视频模型可以展示一只猴子跳过横杆，但它无法将这个跳跃以可回放的3D动作形式返回并放置到3D场景中。本文提出一个模型，可为任意给定的骨架绑定直接共同生成视频与3D动作，同时生成一个将该动作配准到场景中的相机。先前的视频-动作模型要么仅能处理人类骨架（通常需增加数十亿参数），要么从生成的2D姿态图中三角化出3D动作。我们则将3D动作保留在一个支持任意骨架的独立模型中，并通过少量交叉注意力层将其与预训练的视频模型相连接。这种分离设计使动作模型可以先从仅含动作的数据中学习骨架如何运动，而这类数据更容易获得……
tldr: 该论文提出通过少量交叉注意力层将支持任意骨架的独立3D动作模型与预训练视频模型相连接，直接共同生成视频、可回放的3D动作以及将动作配准到3D场景的相机。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes connecting an independent 3D motion model that supports arbitrary rigs to a pretrained video model via a small set of cross-attention layers, directly co-generating video, replayable 3D motion, and a camera that registers the motion to the 3D scene.
